conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; source-observed retained failure context loss
conditional_findings.classification: Original059 Adler finding reassessed at95e, connected to Segovb Lens12 original6533 and delegated Lens11 e275 scopes; no new historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Required strategic asset failure outcome at native failed-event receiver and retained status.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The strategic receiver retains only a formatted asset path while the native event also carries stable asset identity and an owned AssetLoadError; context is discarded before final status serialization.
conditional_findings.trace: Pinned bevy_asset0.19.1 UntypedAssetLoadFailedEvent has id, path and error, and its typed-to-untyped conversion clones path/error. The current capture_asset_failures filters paths using is_required_scene_asset, then sets SceneAssetFailure to a formatted path-only String. Last chains capture before status; status requires failure.0.is_none() for installed readiness and publishes the retained path via status_error. A separate tactical loading-screen receiver similarly retains path in LoadingFailure::Asset; it has separate retry/state ownership and is not automatically aliased.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The strategic failure is not ignored: it prevents installed readiness and reaches the serialized status. A path-only user-facing summary can be a deliberate final display decision; the first loss identified here occurs in retained internal state. Source inspection does not establish an actual failure, supported retry, cross-scene poisoning or user-visible consequences.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit and separate implementation authorization, preserve native asset ID, path and original owned cause through the strategic failure owner until final status; coordinate tactical loading, texture residency and any supported reset/retry lifecycle without assuming they are one defect.
acceptance_requirements: A required strategic asset failure retains its original cause and identity until the final presentation boundary; loading, failed, ready and any supported retry remain distinct.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; exact current source/native loss and earlier e275 attribution connected, actual producers, retries, lifecycle and aliases remain open

conditional_findings.classification: New95e source question connected to earlier Segovb and Adler census-scope concerns; no historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Per-resident-scene census population and its logged diagnostic meaning.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The root gates one census per resident scene, but the mesh query enumerates all Mesh3d entities without requiring descent from that root, and output is labelled City mesh census.
conditional_findings.trace: Last chains update_status then census. With scene root present, assets ready and captures ready, census scans the global Mesh3d query and uses each entity or ancestor Name/component as a label; it does not test scene-root membership. The forge preview command can create separate named Mesh3d children under a forge root in the same browser world; its show command does not release the retained scene. If forge parts coexist at the first census, they satisfy the query and can enter groups, subject to the top20 output limit.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The census may intentionally summarize the entire renderer world at the time a city becomes ready. Actual simultaneous root readiness and forge timing, shown groups, and any benchmark consumer expectations were not established; no world, view or log was run. The 20 group limit bounds output, not scan work.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit and separate implementation authorization, document whether this is a world or city-root census and, if city-specific, associate every counted mesh with the intended scene/presentation owner; preserve other renderer diagnostics explicitly.
acceptance_requirements: Logged population and label agree for resident city, forge and map entities, and the documented group limit is understood by consumers.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; global query and separate forge producer traced, actual timing and intended consumer policy remain open

conditional_findings.classification: New95e source question connected to earlier reviewers’ explicit 36-index heuristic qualification; no historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Meaning and admission of the visible_cuboids count in the city mesh census.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The diagnostic increments visible_cuboids for a visible CPU-resident indexed mesh solely when its index count equals36; index count alone does not prove cuboid geometry.
conditional_findings.trace: census observes ViewVisibility, obtains a Mesh from Assets, calls try_indices and compares indices.len()==36, without checking shape or primitive topology. The counter is serialized to log under visible_cuboids; it is not a render or gameplay predicate.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: A closed hexagonal bipyramid has12 triangular faces, represented by36 triangle indices, yet is not a cuboid. This is a geometric counterexample to the count predicate; no mesh, asset, view, census or log was created or executed.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The counter may intentionally be a cheap proxy for this project’s authored meshes; no supported non-cuboid 36-index mesh or consumer relying on exact cuboid semantics was established. CPU asset residency and ViewVisibility do not independently certify actual GPU draw.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit and separate implementation authorization, either label the count as a 36-index proxy or derive a genuine cuboid classification from an explicit geometry/producer owner.
acceptance_requirements: The diagnostic name and documented semantics distinguish a 36-index proxy from verified cuboid geometry, including missing CPU meshes and visibility limits.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; predicate and symbolic geometry shown, actual mesh populations and metric policy remain open
